set_screw_offset = 5.0

inner_radius = inner_diameter / 2.0

from build123d import *

outer_diameter = 80.0
wall_thickness = 5.0
height = 30.0
central_hole_diameter = 10.0
slot_width = 20.0
slot_depth = 5.0
fillet_radius = 2.0
chamfer_distance = 1.0
rib_thickness = 3.0
rib_height = 20.0
rib_count = 8

outer_radius = outer_diameter / 2.0
inner_radius = outer_radius - wall_thickness

solid_body = Cylinder(outer_radius, height)
top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
bottom_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[0]
solid_body = offset(solid_body, amount=-wall_thickness, openings=[top_face, bottom_face])

solid_body = solid_body - Cylinder(central_hole_diameter / 2, height)

slot_box = Pos(0, 0, height - slot_depth / 2) * Box(slot_width, slot_depth, slot_depth)
solid_body = solid_body - slot_box

top_edges = solid_body.edges().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1:]
solid_body = chamfer(top_edges, chamfer_distance)

bottom_edges = solid_body.edges().sort_by(Axis.Z)[:1]
solid_body = fillet(bottom_edges, fillet_radius)

rib = Pos(inner_radius - rib_thickness / 2, 0, rib_height / 2) * Box(rib_thickness, rib_thickness, rib_height)
ribs = rib
for i in range(1, rib_count):
    angle = i * 360.0 / rib_count
    ribs = ribs + Rot(0, 0, angle) * rib

part = solid_body + ribs
part.name = "hollow_cylinder_with_ribs"
export_step(part, "output.step")
